core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nagib is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Noble, distinguished”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nagib corresponds to the Arabic form نَجِيب (Arabic root ن ج ب (n-j-b); نَجِيب (Najīb)). Its core sense is najib; noble, distinguished. Nagib is a spelling variant of Arabic نَجِيب (Najīb) 'noble, distinguished', from the root ن ج ب (n-j-b). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ناجب (a different form); the correct form is نَجِيب. The source gloss 'Given, Generous' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as najib.

persian.name: نجیب
